search_tool: Search the user's indexed memories and uploaded documents (lexical + embedding similarity).
summary_tool: Truncate/summarize a long text to a short excerpt for the context window.
local_infer: Run a follow-up prompt on the local model (use sparingly; expensive). Uses the active route's GGUF when invoked from the main assistant.
code_sandbox: Execute untrusted code in an isolated Docker sandbox (only when explicitly needed).
workspace_read: Read a UTF-8 text file under VERA_WORKSPACE_ROOT (path traversal blocked).
workspace_list: List files and subdirectories under a path within VERA_WORKSPACE_ROOT.
workspace_write: Write UTF-8 text to a path under VERA_WORKSPACE_ROOT (may require human approval + approvalId).
http_fetch: HTTP GET for allowlisted hosts only (disabled unless VERA_HTTP_FETCH_ENABLED=true).
eval_arithmetic: Evaluate a numeric arithmetic expression with + - * / and parentheses (no variables).
system_info: Read-only process/workspace metadata (Node version, platform, workspace root).
coordination_post: Post a message to the multi-agent coordination bus (same coordinationId as the active agent run). Visible to other runs/steps sharing that session.
github_api: GitHub REST API GET helper (requires VERA_GITHUB_TOKEN). Optional VERA_GITHUB_API_ALLOWLIST=comma-separated path prefixes.
slack_post: Post a short message via Slack Incoming Webhook (requires VERA_SLACK_INCOMING_WEBHOOK_URL). Not interactive OAuth.
